apron.notes: Take the elevated islands above the sump.
apron.title: Hot apron

boulder.notes: Use cover at the base of the runway, then cross the smelter gap.
boulder.title: Smelter chute

bridge.notes: Shoot the fixed coupler. The deck extends and the relief vent purges.
bridge.title: Casting bridge

casting.notes: Cross the lower slag gap and time the relief vent.
casting.title: Casting floor

catwalk.notes: Cross the upper catwalk for salvage.
catwalk.title: Refinery catwalk

chute.notes: Pass both relay interlocks and climb past three flue scouts to daylight.
chute.title: Shaft crown

coolant.notes: Follow the lower vent lane. Its maintenance hatch drops into the basalt.
coolant.title: Cooling trench

drain.notes: Jump the molten crack and stand on the pressure plate to retract the shutter.
drain.title: Quench drain

duct.notes: The upper deck, cooling trench and drain return meet before the first riser.
duct.title: Kiln duct

entry.notes: Cross the first fire gap and follow the cooling line.
entry.title: Smelter Intake

escape.notes: After the squad enters, the door seals and the lava rises. Jump around the solid ledges and chain kicks up the four lit wall bands.
escape.title: Lava escape

exit.notes: Defeat Forge Titan and reach the extraction pad.
exit.title: Extraction

freight.notes: Use the freight relay and lift to reach the salvage deck.
freight.title: Freight vault

gallery.notes: Jump onto the upper meter line from the service deck.
gallery.title: Fuel service gallery

gantry.notes: Jump the grates for the upper supply cache.
gantry.title: Cooling gantry

hoist.notes: Fire across the cage to lower it into the valve gallery. The far service lip offers a second descent.
hoist.title: Inspection cage

intake_riser.notes: Alternate wall kicks to reach the hot apron.
intake_riser.title: Intake riser

lift.notes: Call the lift to the overhead crane.
lift.title: Freight controls

locker.notes: Collect salvage, then climb the east ladder back to the kiln duct.
locker.title: Survey locker

loft.notes: Climb the receiver ladder and work back west for the locker.
loft.title: Inspection loft

meter.notes: Break the fuel-meter cover and activate the first gate relay.
meter.title: Meter cabinet

refinery.notes: Cross the lower refinery and its fire gap.
refinery.title: Refinery trench

room_3296563.notes: Jump across the open exhaust to the upper rim. The lower service walk gives a second approach.
room_3296563.title: Exhaust pier

steps.notes: Use the basalt toe, service grate and maintenance ladder to reach the overhead span.
steps.title: Counterweight stair

sump.notes: Cross the lower channel and climb back to the furnace machinery.
sump.title: Slag sump

titan.notes: Bait Forge Titan into a fallen amber core to open its armor. Use the upper catwalks during lava surges.
titan.title: Forge Titan

trench.notes: Drop to the pipe trench for the repair supply. Jump back towards the meter from the raised repair balcony.
trench.title: Fuel repair trench

valve.notes: The valve opens the drain grille to the east. Drop under the header to reach the escape checkpoint.
valve.title: Valve cabinet

vault.notes: Clear the upper span to collect the cache. Descending ledges lead toward the smelter.
vault.title: Crane vault

warning.notes: Cross the basement and regroup before entering the shaft.
warning.title: Surge checkpoint

transfer_entry.notes: The broken bridge exposes the settling channel below.
transfer_entry.title: Transfer Works

transfer_bridge.notes: Jump the broken spans to keep the high line.
transfer_bridge.title: Broken Crossing

transfer_drain.notes: Descend beneath the crane, jump the slag cut to the drain inspection plinth, then climb the stepped spillway.
transfer_drain.title: Settling Channel

transfer_lock.notes: Slide below the seal. Wall-kick between the guides to exit.
transfer_lock.title: Transfer Lock

survey_loft.notes: Stay high for salvage before dropping to the smelter intake.
survey_loft.title: Survey Crane

discharge.notes: Descend along the pipe shelf and cross the outlet.
discharge.title: Discharge Passage
